title: saiku-web and saiku-launcher line coverage reach 70% and their coverage/test-count ratchets are raised, never lowered

criteria.given: the gated JaCoCo report of a ci build
criteria.then: saiku-core/saiku-web line coverage is at least 70%; its ratchet in .coverage-thresholds.json is raised to just under the measured value (69 for 70.38 measured), and scripts/check-coverage.sh passes
saiku-launcher line coverage is at least 70%; its ratchet is raised to just under the measured value (73 for 74.25 measured under the CI configuration)

criteria.given: the tests added to saiku-web and saiku-launcher
criteria.then: the surefire floors in .github/test-floors.json are raised (web 1700, launcher 140) so no existing test can be silently dropped, and no floor anywhere is lowered
